description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'WorkShiftDaoTest' for testing the 'WorkShiftDao' data access object that manages CRUD operations and queries related to work shifts within the OrangeHRM application. It sets up test data, and includes multiple test methods to verify fetching, saving, editing, deleting, and listing employees by work shift.

classes.name: WorkShiftDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class verifying the functionality of the WorkShiftDao data access object in the context of the OrangeHRM application, including test setup and multiple test cases for CRUD operations and data retrieval related to work shifts.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture by creating an instance of WorkShiftDao and populating test data from a YAML fixture file.

methods.name: testGetWorkShiftById
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a work shift by ID, verifying the name, hours per day, and start/end times.

methods.name: testGetWorkShiftList
methods.description: Verifies the listing of work shifts returned by the DAO with a default filter.

methods.name: testSaveWorkShift
methods.description: Tests saving a new work shift object and verifies its properties after save.

methods.name: testEditWorkShift
methods.description: Tests editing an existing work shift and verifies updated fields and ID.

methods.name: testDeleteWorkShifts
methods.description: Tests deleting multiple work shifts by IDs and verifies the count of deletions.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeListByWorkShiftId
methods.description: Verifies listing employees associated with specific work shifts, checking counts and employee details.
